# OwnerManager

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/04c494d92ce87df3b9ba252c17541e08e28fdf97/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/base/OwnerManager.sol)

**Inherits:** [SelfAuthorized](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/common/abstract.SelfAuthorized)

**Title:** OwnerManager - Manages Safe owners and a threshold to authorize transactions.

**Authors:** Stefan George - @Georgi87, Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

<i>

Uses a linked list to store the owners because the code generate by the solidity compiler
     is more efficient than using a dynamic array.

</i>

## Constants

### SENTINEL_OWNERS

```solidity
address internal constant SENTINEL_OWNERS = address(0x1);
```

## State Variables

### owners

```solidity
mapping(address => address) internal owners;
```

### ownerCount

```solidity
uint256 internal ownerCount;
```

### threshold

```solidity
uint256 internal threshold;
```

## Functions

<a id="setupowners-address-uint256"></a>

### setupOwners

Sets the initial storage of the contract.

```solidity
function setupOwners(address[] memory _owners, uint256 _threshold) internal;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _owners | `address[]` | List of Safe owners. |
| _threshold | `uint256` | Number of required confirmations for a Safe transaction. |

<a id="addownerwiththreshold-address-uint256"></a>

### addOwnerWithThreshold

Adds the owner `owner` to the Safe and updates the threshold to `_threshold`.

<i>

This can only be done via a Safe transaction.

</i>

```solidity
function addOwnerWithThreshold(address owner, uint256 _threshold) public authorized;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| owner | `address` | New owner address. |
| _threshold | `uint256` | New threshold. |

<a id="removeowner-address-address-uint256"></a>

### removeOwner

Removes the owner `owner` from the Safe and updates the threshold to `_threshold`.

<i>

This can only be done via a Safe transaction.

</i>

```solidity
function removeOwner(address prevOwner, address owner, uint256 _threshold) public authorized;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| prevOwner | `address` | Owner that pointed to the owner to be removed in the linked list |
| owner | `address` | Owner address to be removed. |
| _threshold | `uint256` | New threshold. |

<a id="swapowner-address-address-address"></a>

### swapOwner

Replaces the owner `oldOwner` in the Safe with `newOwner`.

<i>

This can only be done via a Safe transaction.

</i>

```solidity
function swapOwner(address prevOwner, address oldOwner, address newOwner) public authorized;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| prevOwner | `address` | Owner that pointed to the owner to be replaced in the linked list |
| oldOwner | `address` | Owner address to be replaced. |
| newOwner | `address` | New owner address. |

<a id="changethreshold-uint256"></a>

### changeThreshold

Changes the threshold of the Safe to `_threshold`.

<i>

This can only be done via a Safe transaction.

</i>

```solidity
function changeThreshold(uint256 _threshold) public authorized;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _threshold | `uint256` | New threshold. |

<a id="getthreshold"></a>

### getThreshold

Returns the number of required confirmations for a Safe transaction aka the threshold.

```solidity
function getThreshold() public view returns (uint256);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | Threshold number. |

<a id="isowner-address"></a>

### isOwner

Returns if `owner` is an owner of the Safe.

```solidity
function isOwner(address owner) public view returns (bool);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| owner | `address` |  |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bool` | Boolean if owner is an owner of the Safe. |

<a id="getowners"></a>

### getOwners

Returns a list of Safe owners.

```solidity
function getOwners() public view returns (address[] memory);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `address[]` | Array of Safe owners. |
